The historic decree eliminates approximately one-quarter of all U.S. capital punishment sentences, drawing sharp rebukes from Donald Trump, vows from local prosecutors to continue seeking the death penalty, and a lawsuit challenging the commutations over alleged failures to notify district attorneys.

note: Lawsuit challenges Newsom's mass commutation, citing failures to notify district attorneys

before.story: COP31 Climate Talks Collapse in Antalya Without Deal
before.summary: The 31st UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya collapsed without a major political agreement—the first such breakdown since Copenhagen in 2009—after nearly 200 nations deadlocked over a final text omitting fossil fuel phase-out language. The EU, UK, Panama, Vanuatu, and developing nations rejected the draft backed by India, China, Saudi Arabia, Japan, and Venezuela, ending a turbulent summit marked by record overtime, a $1.6 billion Turkey-AIIB climate deal, and protests over a $50 million adaptation pledge.

before.story: Russian Strike Kills One Near Kyiv
before.summary: Overnight Russian bombardments involving more than 400 drones and 110 missiles targeted Ukrainian infrastructure, causing a five-storey residential building to collapse in Dymer, north of Kyiv. The regional death toll rose to at least 15—including 11 in Dymer—as emergency crews rescued a 7-year-old boy and a 79-year-old woman from the rubble while continuing to search for missing residents.

after.story: Russian Strike Kills One Near Kyiv

The regional death toll rose to at least 15—including 11 in Dymer—as emergency crews rescued a 7-year-old boy and a 79-year-old woman trapped for 22 hours beneath concrete slabs.
